bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks aren't allowed at The Howlin' Wolf, and all guests may be searched on entry. No weapons of any kind are allowed.
bagPolicy.quote: Because of previous policies on outside food/beverage and weapons, backpacks are not permitted in The Howlin Wolf.

parking.summary: The Howlin' Wolf hasn't published parking details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Howlin' Wolf. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: No outside food or beverages are allowed into The Howlin' Wolf. Plan to eat and drink inside the venue.
concessions.quote: No outside food or beverages are allowed into the venue.

accessibility.summary: The Howlin' Wolf hasn't published accessibility details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: The Howlin' Wolf hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Shows are 18+ unless noted otherwise, and you need a current government-issued ID such as a driver's license, passport or military ID to get in. Buy through The Howlin' Wolf box office or its website, since tickets from third-party resellers may not be honored.
ticketPickup.quote: All shows are all 18 + unless otherwise noted. Valid ID required for entry.

gates.summary: The Howlin' Wolf is general admission with standing room on the floor. The main room has a limited number of barstools, and The Den has chairs around the room. Set times can change, so check your event page.
gates.quote: Venue is general admission with the floor as standing room only.
